senses.gloss: (v. preced; cmp. b. h. כָּסַף, כָּלָה) to look out for, espy.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 35a">Sabb. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>דָּוֵי למזרח</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D00013"><he>דָּאוֵי</he></cite>) he looked eastward (for the reflection of the setting sun). Ib. 53ᵇ they raise their nostrils [read:] <he>ומסגי כי דָּוֵי</he> (Ms. O. <he>כדובי</he>) and march like looking out (for the wolf).
<cite ref="Keritot 6a">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>דְּווּ לפומיה וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חזו</he>) watch the lips of &c.
<cite ref="Tamid 26b:23">Tam. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>דוי להכא וכ׳</he> he (the watchman) looks out in both directions.
